sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Garg
Order 21/04/2023

The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of Fir
No.0283/2022, Police Station Kotwali Nagaur, District Nagaur, for offences under Sections 420,
467, 468, 471, 120-B & 447 of Ipc.

Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report dated 20.04.2023 received from the SHO, Police Station Kotwali Nagaur, District Nagaur wherein it has been mentioned that Police has already filed a charge-sheet against the present petitioner.
The said report is hereby taken on record.
In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.
